_about: Two forms of one person's name that the owner has confirmed are the same person -- a request filed under "Samuel Hoehn" by the member-elect the results print as "Sam Hoehn". A short form is never guessed (the owner, 18 November 2026): a name not here matches only as it is written. Edited by a person; no generator writes this file, and preflight fails if one tries. src/pages/build_lsrs.py reads it (name_forms): a request whose sponsor is written as `form` is matched as if it were written as `is`, and so goes to the one person that name names, or to nobody where it names nobody or two.
_how: One entry per form: `form`, the name as a source writes it; `is`, the form the person is matched under; `said`, the owner's words; `by` and `on`, who said so and the day; `evidence`, what was compared. `form` and `is` are whole names, never an initial or a surname alone.

forms.evidence: LSR 2027-0708, a House resolution request, names its sponsor "Samuel Hoehn"; the 2026 general election results print the Coos 1 member-elect as "Sam Hoehn". Asked whether they are one person, the owner answered "Yes, same person" on 18 November 2026.
